observations: Brand 'SKYRUN' is visible on the top door in photo 0 and on the back label in photo 2.
Model 'BCD-207S' is legible on the technical label in photo 2.
The freezer compartment in photo 1 shows significant brown staining and signs of corrosion along the bottom edge.
Protective plastic film is peeling off the lower door in photo 0.
The back of the unit shows the compressor and condenser coils in photo 2.
The interior of the main (lower) fridge compartment is not shown in any photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows significant staining and possible rust on the freezer floor and lip.

risks.risk: The unit may not cool or freeze.
risks.proof: A video showing the interior with frost on the coils or a thermometer showing a low temperature.

risks.risk: The main fridge compartment (lower door) may be damaged or missing shelves.
risks.proof: A photo of the lower compartment with the door open.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged interior or missing parts

risks.risk: The compressor may be noisy or failing.
risks.proof: A video with sound of the refrigerator running.

proof_requests: Photo of the lower fridge compartment open to see shelves and condition.
Video of the unit plugged in and running to hear the compressor.
Photo or video showing ice formation in the freezer to prove cooling.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the photos. While the seller's claims of being 'neat' are contradicted by visible stains and rust, the item can be priced at its worst-case functional and aesthetic state.
